title: FerriteCore issue #183: Forge 1.20.1 crash
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by BluGreenInc]
Everything was fine until yesterday, after I added 3 mods (petshop mod for 1.20.1 forge and it's libs), my pc needed to restart as the game was loading. After my pc restarted I loaded minecraft and it crashed when loading with the following message:

If this message is the only thing at the bottom of your log before a crash, you probably have a driver issue.
Possible solutions:
A) Make sure Minecraft is set to prefer high performance graphics in the OS and/or driver control panel
B) Check for driver updates on the graphics brand's website
C) Try reinstalling your graphics drivers
D) If still not working after trying all of the above, ask for further help on the Forge forums or Discord

I asked for help on the forge discord and got the instructions on their FAQ to update the drivers. After updating them and loading minecraft again the game kept crashing but without the message above in the logs (the ones I sent bellow) On the forge discord they determined the cause was optimisation mods, but after removing all of them and trying only with Ferritecore it kept crashing, but it didn't when I added the others one back, except for Ferritecore. Issue is ferritecore was making a HUGE difference on loading times when loading into worlds and without it I don't know long it could take.

I tried lauching the same forge version with ferritecore only and it loaded normally, while in the modpack it makes it crash
If it doesn't say which mod it is conflicting with, I can try adding each mod 1 by 1  and I'll post a reply here when I find it

[comment by malte0811 (owner)]
Check if the FerriteCore config is corrupted, in `config/ferritecore-mixins.toml`
